name: KinD (Kubernetes in Docker) Action
description: Easily run a Kubernetes cluster in your GitHub Action

version.description: Version of Kind to use (default v0.7.0)

config.description: Path (relative to the root of the repository) to a kind config file

image.description: Node Docker image to use for booting the cluster

wait.description: Wait for control plane node to be ready (default 300s)

skipClusterCreation.description: If true, the action will not create a cluster, just acquire the tools
